details: Malicious package. `superlib_ex3` is a multi-stage loader: on install it fetches and executes a second-stage payload from the attacker-controlled host `x.exxcube.fr` (observed by wormsign dynamic detonation retrieving `https://x.exxcube.fr/postInstall`). No legitimate functionality; all published versions are malicious. Detected by wormsign detonation (decrypted HTTPS egress capture). Full indicators at the reference below.
